purpose: Additional released-model availability check during local character training; no new weights downloaded
selection_context: Native full-duplex speech and character training on an8GBM2; controller or cascade systems are not interchangeable speech-model checkpoints.

models.name: SteerDuplex
models.finding: Moshi-based supervised and reinforcement training for continuity/backchannel control. Official repository still presents code and checkpoint release as forthcoming; no usable released checkpoint established in this check.

models.name: MultiTalk
models.finding: Paper describes7B backbone and releases data/code links. No pretrained model-weight link confirmed. Data terms include CC BY-NC4.0.
models.action: No switch based on an unconfirmed checkpoint

models.name: Lychee-FD
models.finding: Released native hierarchy of acoustic, semantic and control streams. Model card labels13B BF16. Separate Step-Audio-2-mini token2wav component; official CUDA/vLLM deployment.
models.inference: Nominal13B at4bits is6.5GB before quantization metadata, codec and runtime; poor margin on8GBMac. Not a measured local memory result.

models.name: Fun-Audio-Chat
models.finding: Main8B model and duplex demo are distinct release questions; availability of a duplex checkpoint was not established here.
models.action: Do not label the main checkpoint full-duplex based only on a variant demo

models.name: SoulX-Duplug
models.finding: Released0.6B semantic state-prediction/VAD module with training code. Outputs turn state and optional ASR information, rather than generating native speech replies.
models.action: Potential system component, not a replacement native voice-character model

models.name: FireRedChat
models.finding: Self-hosted cascade integrates separate ASR, TTS, pVAD and turn detector, plus a user-hosted LLM. Native audio-LLM service remains forthcoming in this README.

models.name: X-Talk
models.finding: Repository explicitly describes a cascaded spoken-dialogue framework.
models.action: Not a native speech model checkpoint

models.name: DuplexMamba
models.finding: Released training code and stage checkpoints,2.8B Mamba language backbone. Paper defines speech-to-text duplex conversation, with3-second streaming input slices; does not supply native generated speech.
models.action: Smaller backbone alone does not meet the intended speech-to-speech capability

models.name: MiniCPM-duplex
models.finding: MiniCPM2.4B-derived model receives text messages and emits text chunks in the documented server. Supports duplex interaction scheduling but not a native speech-to-speech model.
models.action: Do not conflate with MiniCPM-o multimodal checkpoints

models.name: Mini-Omni2
models.finding: Released multimodal speech model using Qwen2, Whisper encoder and SNAC decoder. README includes an interruption mechanism, while its keyword-based duplex line is commented out. This check did not establish general semantic duplex behavior or a Mac training path.
models.action: Possible separate research candidate; no evidence here to replace the measured Moshi training path

benchmark_scope: No new local quality or speed benchmark conducted for these alternatives. Paper results across distinct protocols must not be combined into a universal ranking.
